title: Circuits
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Circuits
learningObjectives: Identify the schematic symbols for a battery, an on/off switch, a resistor, and an LED in a series loop
Trace the path of current from the battery's positive terminal through the switch, resistor, and LED back to the negative terminal
Predict whether the LED turns red or stays black when the switch is toggled, and explain why an open switch stops the animated current
Explain how the animated wire conveys direction of current flow around the series loop
Design a complex sketch by decomposing it into separate drawBattery, drawSwitch, resistor, LED, and animated-wire functions before assembling them
